items.html: And the Malchut of AA was not recognizable, as was explained by us in the introduction to the explanation of the Idra Zuta, for there was in AA only nine Sefirot from Keter to Yesod, since the RDL"A is the aspect of Atik, and AA remained in the aspect of nine Sefirot alone. But from the light of the spreading of the NHY of Atik Yomin, which clothe in AA, from there the aspect of the Malchut of AA was made, and the ten Sefirot were completed in it. And in this you will understand how the Malchut is always greater than the male above her, and therefore she is called the crown of her husband.
